# compelem-store

> A lightweight, reactive global store for CompElem — Pinia/Vuex-like state management for Web Components.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md) - Installation, usage, and API reference
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/holyhigh2/compelem-store) - Source code and issues

## Features

- Reactive state with automatic component subscription
- Define store with state, getters, and actions
- Singleton per store ID
- `patch()` for batch updates
- `reset()` to reinitialize state
- Subscribe to mutations
- Automatic cleanup (WeakRef-based)

## Quick Start

```ts
import { defineStore } from 'compelem-store'

const counterStore = defineStore({
  id: 'counter',
  state: () => ({ count: 0, step: 1 }),
  getters: {
    double: (state) => state.count * 2,
  },
  actions: {
    inc() { this.count += this.step },
  },
})

// In component render()
const store = counterStore
return h`<span>${store.count} / ${store.double}</span>
         <button @click=${() => store.inc()}>+1</button>`
```

## API

| API | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `defineStore(options)` | Create store (singleton per id) |
| `getStoreById(id)` | Get registered store facade |
| `disposeStore(id)` / `resetStores()` | Unregister stores (for testing) |
| `useStore(store, comp)` | Explicit component subscription |
| `store.state` | Reactive state proxy |
| `store.patch(partial)` | Batch update |
| `store.reset()` | Reinitialize state |
| `store.subscribe(cb)` | Subscribe to mutations |
| `store.connect(comp)` / `disconnect(comp)` | Manual subscription |
